tells.1: “A little measuring done. A little joy delivered.” feels engineered for symmetry, with vague emotional language substituting for a concrete benefit.

reason: Version 4 has the best balance of warmth, clarity, and scannable structure; version 1 has a stronger copywriting voice but occasionally overplays it.
